scenes.headline: StayBent JaeBee
scenes.narration: Want a short track blade that moves with you, not against you? This is the StayBent JaeBee, the most flexible blade in the StayBent range.

scenes.headline: Why it feels different
bullets: Lips even more flexible than the QCS
scenes.narration: Its lips flex even more than the QCS. The tube tapers towards each end, so the tips have more give than the middle. That keeps it smooth through technical corners.

scenes.headline: Bimetal or full PM steel
scenes.narration: Choose bimetal for easy sharpening, or full PM steel to hold an edge longer if you train most days.

scenes.headline: StayBent JaeBee
scenes.narration: It comes in eight lengths, from 14.5 to 18. Find yours at the link in bio.
